## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes.
- [ ] Every commit is signed off with `git commit -s`, and the sign-off matches the author.
- [ ] Text and code are English.
- [ ] New source files carry the SPDX header.
- [ ] Docs and `docs/unsupported.md` are updated when a documented limit changes.
- [ ] No ADR-0012 control is weakened and no security or compliance claim is added.
- [ ] No secrets are committed.
